title: Settings
providerIntro: For categories and a short commentary I can use a tool installed on this computer. Without one I only do the arithmetic.
example: Amounts and dates look like this: {{amount}}, {{date}}.
privacy1: I read and keep your statements on this computer. The local server only listens on 127.0.0.1.
privacy2: Card number, name, address, IBAN and customer number are removed before anything is saved.
privacy3: Only the date, description, amount, currency and type of each transaction, plus totals the code computed, go to the tool you chose.
privacy4: Code computes the totals and installments; the model never produces a number.
privacy5: kalan is open source (MIT licence). You can check all of this by reading the code.
